att_anxious.definition: Describing a person who reads any drop in a partner's availability as a sign that the bond is at risk.
att_anxious.example: When he was busy, his anxious side read the quiet as a message about him.

balanced.definition: The same operation has been applied to both sides.
balanced.example: The equation stays balanced if you add the same number to both sides.

burrow.definition: The home a rabbit digs under the ground. It is soft and safe and it has a round door.
burrow.example: Pip's burrow has a round door and soft walls.

calcium.definition: A mineral from food that makes your bones and teeth strong.
calcium.example: Milk is full of calcium, and calcium keeps my bones strong.

farm_animal.definition: An animal that people keep on a farm to help them, like a cow or a chicken.
farm_animal.example: My uncle has a farm with cows and chickens.

grandmother.definition: Your mum's mother or your dad's mother. You often call her grandma.
grandmother.example: My grandmother grows vegetables in the garden.

include.definition: To make room for somebody in the group, the game or the talk.
include.example: We included the new boy in our game.

new_friend.definition: A child you have just met. Saying hello twice makes a new child feel welcome.
new_friend.example: I have a new friend in class 4B.

ray.definition: One thin path of light, like a single beam of sunshine through a gap in the clouds.
ray.example: A ray of light fell right onto my book.

wh_descaling.definition: Removing the mineral scale that builds up inside a tank and on the heating element.
wh_descaling.example: Descaling is done at the service interval in hard water areas.

wing.definition: The flat part that helps a bird to lift into the air. On this bicycle, the wings are only paper, but they still lift.
wing.example: The newspaper wings lifted when he rang the bell.
